svg.text: Test 20261118-01 WS2812B dome baseline: bench circuit, rev 20261118-05 (draft)
Blue Pill pins are named as printed on the board silkscreen. Red = 5 V, blue = GND, black = signal. USB-C powers the board and loads firmware (no ST-Link).
Setup A below (as tested 2026-11-18): two series 1N4007 diodes in the 5V feed, 3.8 V at the disks. Setup B (74AHCT125N, 5 V) follows the Setup A parts table.
Pins counted from the USB-C end of the bottom row
1N4007 x2, band (bar) toward disks; 3.8 V at disks (measured)
Pad marks (5V / DIN / DOUT / GND) on the actual disks must be verified before wiring; the pad layout is not drawn. Each disk carries its own 0.1 uF capacitor.
No level shifter: data is 3.3 V. The two series diodes lower the disk supply to 3.8 V (measured), so the data-high threshold (0.7 x VDD) is about 2.7 V. See the test card.
D3 anode; D3 cathode to D4 anode; D4 cathode to D1 5V, D2 5V
SW1 pin 2, D1 GND, D2 GND
in 5V feed; band toward D1/D2; 3.8 V at disks
Setup B (new, added 2026-11-18): 74AHCT125N level shifter, LED supply 5.0 V
Part not yet received (Scott ordering); not built or verified. Same Blue Pill pins as Setup A (B15 data, B12 switch, 5V, G). No diodes in the 5V feed. Intended to replace Setup A once verified.
Red = 5 V, blue = GND, black = signal. An arc where wires cross means no connection. U2 pin numbers per the TI SN74AHCT125 datasheet (not re-checked this session).
+5 V rail (Blue Pill pin 5V, USB 5 V)
U2 pin 14, D1 5V, D2 5V, C1 (+); no diodes in the feed
SW1 pin 2, U2 pin 7, D1 GND, D2 GND, C1 (-)
Pin 1 (1OE) to GND; pins 5, 9, 12 (2A, 3A, 4A) to GND
Scott ordering; arrives in about 2 days (2026-11-18); to be tested on receipt
0.1 uF ceramic, across U2 pins 14 and 7
Proposed (standard practice); not a Scott decision; value to confirm
D3, D4 (1N4007) not used in Setup B
Once Setup B is verified and tested, Setup A (2-diode) can likely be deleted from this drawing and the test card (Scott, 2026-11-18).
